scope: All 18 labeled cases attempted with Codex and Pi using full committed journeys, mobile/desktop and light/dark, fast/default QA budgets. All 36 selected reports are partial. Focused deep-budget UX and hosted checkout acceptance are separate.
model: custom-node-openai/gpt-6.1-sol via the AI Gateway custom endpoint
limitations: Report availability does not mean every planned cell completed. Zero completed journey/cells are coverage gaps, not passes.
Rule/journey matching is a provisional detection signal; human-confirmed defect precision is not available. Static probe proof is distinct from hosted model quorum.
Mixed implementation builds: earlier full runs predate identity, trace and checkpoint corrections. Retries retain their own run/snapshot identities; earlier misses are not relabeled.
Unknown dollar prices and missing token measurements remain null. Reported cost excludes superseded attempts and focused/hosted acceptance.
Completed_cells counts passed or failed journey/cell outcomes; cost.cells counts measured browser chain/cells, with shared dependencies counted once.
selection_policy: Prefer /tmp/rio-qa-expanded-retries-final/<harness>/<case>/<case>.json when present, else /tmp/rio-qa-expanded-evaluation/<harness>/<case>/<case>.json; original Codex missing-confirmation and clean fall back to /tmp/rio-qa-eval-acceptance-codex/<case>.json. No selection based on detection success.
